sections.overview:
twitter-mcp-js is a complete Twitter API MCP server providing 32 tools for seamless social media integration, analytics, and automation. Built for marketing workflows, it enables programmatic access to Twitter functionality through a standardized MCP interface. This skill supports both social media management and data-driven analytics use cases.
Automate tweet publishing and scheduling across campaigns
Extract Twitter analytics and engagement metrics for reporting
Monitor brand mentions and competitor activity on Twitter
Integrate Twitter data into broader marketing automation workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/yolleygit/twitter-mcp-js`
sections.usage:
```
Create a Twitter campaign strategy for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector using the Twitter MCP JS tools. Include audience targeting, content calendar, and engagement tactics. Use the following data: [DATA].
```
